# ToJson

Writes a value as JSON text.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
ToJson(value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | any | The value to write. Any value, null included, except a function: a function, at any depth, is a runtime error. So is a value that holds itself, is nested too deeply or whose text would pass the host's maximum value size, and a string or property name that holds an unpaired surrogate. |

## Returns

String. The JSON text of value, with no spaces or line breaks between its parts. A number is written in its string form, as `1.5` for `1.50`; null is written as `null`. Properties are written in the order the object holds them. Never null.

## Example

`ToJson({"a": [1, true, null]})` returns `"{\"a\":[1,true,null]}"`.
